about: Prices for estimated_cost_usd in the cost ledger (.transcription/costs.jsonl), USD per million tokens. Fill a price only from a cited source; leave it null with a note otherwise. Read by transcribe.estimate_cost; costs.py reports the ledger.

claude.source: claude -p total_cost_usd (modelUsage costBasis 'list'); no table price needed

deepseek-flash.source: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing, read 2026-11-03 (deepseek-flash peak column; no effective date on the page)
deepseek-flash.note: Peak 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Monday to Friday; off-peak is half. Chinese public holidays (all off-peak) are not modelled, so a holiday call is overestimated. completion_tokens (which include reasoning tokens in DeepSeek's usage) are priced as output; the page does not state reasoning-token billing.

gpt-6-astra.note: API list-price equivalent: codex exec may run under a ChatGPT plan rather than API billing; long-context rates from the same page apply above 272K input tokens.
